How to read the counts

Grothendieck counts mean ring types reported as realized, subject to the research caution above. A ≥ sign marks a lower bound in a band containing unresolved fusion rings; the eventual total could be larger. The Grothendieck view omits rows containing only zeros. Fusion view includes the separate census bands, including those without categorification results; the full fusion-ring census table ↗ covers more bands.

03 / EXPLICIT REALIZATIONS

Ring catalogue

TENSOR · CHARACTER TABLE · FORMAL CODEGREES · MODEL
Choose a rank and multiplicity above.

Values marked ≈ are computed numerical approximations. Fusion coefficients, duals, invertible objects, and codegree polynomials where shown come from exact integer arithmetic.

Extended Haagerup EH1 · rank 6, multiplicity 7. The known model R6_7_2274 comes from the Acta Mathematica construction of Bigelow–Morrison–Peters–Snyder. Its fusion rules are given by Grossman–Morrison–Penneys–Peters–Snyder, The Extended Haagerup fusion categories, Ann. Sci. Éc. Norm. Supér. (4) 56 (2023), no. 2, 589–664, §2.1, p. 597 (arXiv).
